parameters.text:
You are an expert ATS and career consultant AI. Analyze the resume text below and extract all key information. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no explanation.

Resume Text:
{{ $json.resumeText }}

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "candidate": { "name": "", "email": "", "phone": "", "location": "", "linkedin_url": "", "github_url": "" },
  "professional": { "current_title": "", "seniority": "", "years_experience": 0, "industry": "", "domain": "" },
  "skills": { "technical": [], "soft": [], "tools": [], "certifications": [], "languages_spoken": [] },
  "education": { "degree": "", "field": "", "university": "", "graduation_year": null },
  "work_history": [{ "company": "", "role": "", "duration": "", "highlights": [] }],
  "search": {
    "suggested_titles": [],
    "keywords": [],
    "salary_range": { "min": null, "max": null, "currency": "INR" },
    "remote_score": 0
  },
  "projects": [{ "name": "", "description": "", "tech_stack": [], "impact": "" }]
}

You are an expert career matching AI. Score each job against the candidate profile below.

Candidate Profile:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.resumeData, null, 2) }}

Jobs to Score:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.aggregatedJobs.map(j => ({ id: j.id, title: j.title, company: j.company, platform: j.platform, location: j.location, description: j.description ? j.description.substring(0, 400) : '', required_skills: j.required_skills || [], remote: j.remote })), null, 2) }}

For EACH job return a JSON array. Return ONLY the JSON array, no markdown, no explanation:
[
  {
    "job_id": "exact id from input",
    "match_score": 0-100,
    "match_reasons": ["reason 1", "reason 2"],
    "missing_skills": ["skill"],
    "strengths": ["strength"],
    "application_priority": "high|medium|low",
    "cover_letter_angle": "one sentence unique pitch angle",
    "red_flags": []
  }
]
